promise: A host read from the user's own ~/.ssh/config is never written back into Hangar's include.
why: Hangar's Include sits above the user's own file and ssh_config is first-match-wins, so a second copy of their host would silently outrank the definition they wrote by hand.
command: scripts/test.sh --filter SSHConfigImportTests 2>&1 | grep -q 'with 0 failures' && grep -q 'guard instance.isWrittenToSSHConfig' app/Sources/HangarCore/SSHConfigWriter.swift
